description: Potassium chloride was discontinued at discharge without documented rationale or recent serum potassium assessment after increasing furosemide dose.
evidence_in_history: Current medications include potassium chloride 20 mEq daily; lab potassium levels were normal but patient remained on potassium supplementation while furosemide dose was increased to twice daily.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge medications omitted potassium chloride with a note that it was discontinued without potassium level reassessment or documented rationale.
suggested_correction: Document recent potassium levels before discontinuation or monitor potassium closely after stopping supplementation to avoid hypokalemia.

description: No endocrinology referral or appointment planned despite persistently elevated HbA1c indicating suboptimal diabetes control.
evidence_in_history: Plan from outpatient visit included considering endocrinology referral if HbA1c did not improve; latest HbA1c values remain elevated around 7.6-7.8%.
evidence_in_summary: Follow-up instructions note no endocrinology referral or scheduled appointment despite glycemic control concerns.
suggested_correction: Arrange endocrinology referral or consultation to optimize diabetes management prior to or shortly after discharge.

description: No scheduled nephrology follow-up despite CKD stage 3 and evidence of renal function decline and elevations in BUN and creatinine.
evidence_in_history: CKD stage 3 diagnosis with stable but elevated and slightly rising BUN and creatinine over last 6 months; plans to monitor labs and dietitian consult planned outpatient.
evidence_in_summary: No nephrology follow-up appointment scheduled or recommended despite risk for progression and acute on chronic kidney injury noted on admission.
suggested_correction: Schedule nephrology outpatient follow-up to monitor CKD progression and optimize renal care.

description: No documentation of patient education materials provided or confirmation of patient understanding of discharge instructions, particularly regarding new medication changes and monitoring.
evidence_in_history: Plan included patient education on weight monitoring and diet; patient reported adherence but struggled with diet and fatigue.
evidence_in_summary: No documentation found of education materials or patient comprehension discussion at discharge.
suggested_correction: Provide and document patient education on medication changes, warning signs, diet, and monitoring; confirm patient understanding before discharge.

description: No formal diabetic or renal dietitian consultation obtained either during admission or arranged at discharge despite documented complexities in diabetes and CKD management.
evidence_in_history: Outpatient plan included dietitian referral; labs and clinical notes indicate suboptimal diabetes and CKD control; patient reported struggles with diet adherence.
evidence_in_summary: Noted lack of formal dietitian consult during admission or at discharge.
suggested_correction: Coordinate dietitian consultation for diabetes and CKD dietary counseling to support outpatient management.

description: No insulin dose adjustment or medication changes made to address persistently suboptimal glycemic control despite elevated HbA1c levels.
evidence_in_history: Insulin glargine dose unchanged; HbA1c remains elevated with some fluctuation (7.6-7.8%).
evidence_in_summary: Hospital course notes no insulin or diabetic medication changes despite elevated glucose and HbA1c.
suggested_correction: Evaluate need for insulin titration or additional diabetes therapy before discharge or during follow-up.

description: No documentation discussing sulfa allergy in the context of patient’s current medication regimen or potential cross-reactivity risks.
evidence_in_history: Patient has documented sulfa allergy with anaphylaxis; no new medications/potential sulfa drugs listed.
evidence_in_summary: Sulfa allergy noted but no discussion regarding impact on therapy or warnings provided.
suggested_correction: Document assessment of allergy risks related to current and future medications and educate patient accordingly.

description: Cardiology outpatient appointment was suggested but not scheduled or coordinated before discharge.
evidence_in_history: Patient has CHF with NYHA class II and S3 gallop; plan includes cardiology follow-up in outpatient notes.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary notes cardiology follow-up suggested but not scheduled.
suggested_correction: Schedule cardiology outpatient appointment prior to or immediately after discharge for continuity of care.
